fusions.name: Fixing Glance
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. Your gaze deals 8 damage, up to 1.5 times that at 7 tiles, and leaves it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Petrifying Stare
fusions.desc: Stares down a cone 5 tiles long, dealing 12 damage, stunning everything caught for 1 second and leaving it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Meeting the Gaze
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 20% for 10 seconds, and pulls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Panopticon
fusions.desc: When you put a condition on an enemy, your critical hit chance rises by 15% for your next strike, for up to 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
